other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Applicant must be engaged in any building and other construction work
Applicant must be registered under the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have an active membership of the Board
The son or daughter must be enrolled in any grade from Class I to Post Graduate Level/Professional Course
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly educational allowance ranging from ₹300 to ₹2,000 depending on the child’s class or course of study.
